business_problem: MiQ needed a better way to support agent-assisted media planning and campaign optimization because massive audience and campaign datasets were spread across separate tools, forcing planners to manually stitch together insight before making recommendations.
solution_summary: MiQ uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support agent-assisted media planning and campaign optimization. The implementation replaced a legacy state where massive audience and campaign datasets were spread across separate tools, forcing planners to manually stitch together insight before making recommendations. Campaign performance data and audience data move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, Genie, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver agent-assisted campaign plans and audience insights.
